lines.speaker: women
lines.text: Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands!

lines.speaker: saul
lines.text: They give him more than me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: From that day, Saul watched David with jealous eyes.

lines.speaker: saul
lines.text: I will pin David to the wall!

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: LORD, be my hiding place!

lines.speaker: jonathan
lines.text: If I shoot past the boy, you must run away.

lines.speaker: jonathan
lines.text: Is not the arrow beyond you? Hurry!

lines.speaker: jonathan
lines.text: Go in peace. The LORD is between you and me forever.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: I am hungry. Do you have any bread?

lines.speaker: ahimelech
lines.text: Only the holy bread. Take it.

lines.speaker: ahimelech
lines.text: And here is Goliath's sword, wrapped in cloth.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: There is none like it. Give it to me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: David hid in a cave. People in trouble came to join him.

lines.speaker: new-follower
lines.text: I'm in debt and in trouble. Can I follow you?

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Come. We will trust the LORD together.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: About four hundred men followed David.

lines.speaker: david-men
lines.text: This is your chance! The LORD gave him to you!

lines.speaker: ui
lines.text: cut a corner of his robe

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: My lord the king! I would not harm the LORD's anointed.

lines.speaker: saul
lines.text: You are more righteous than I.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A rich man named Nabal was rude to David's men.

lines.speaker: abigail
lines.text: Please, my lord, don't take revenge. Take this gift.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Blessed be the LORD who sent you today.

lines.speaker: abishai
lines.text: Let me strike him once with the spear!

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: No. Do not destroy him.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Here is the king's spear! Send someone to get it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Raiders had taken all the wives and children away.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Shall I chase them?

lines.speaker: lord
lines.text: Pursue, for you will recover all.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: David got back everything. Nothing was missing.

lines.speaker: ui
lines.text: Chapter 3 complete — The Fugitive. Next: The King.
